reason: A DSH Web GUI plugin for viewing archived sessions, unarchiving them, and permanently deleting sessions through patched navigation and session-management interfaces.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供归档会话查看、取消归档和永久删除功能，并在界面中加入相应的显示与操作控件。
summaries.en: Adds archived-session viewing, unarchiving, and permanent deletion controls to the DSH Web GUI.

capabilities: Adds archived-session visibility and styling controls to the DSH Web GUI
Provides unarchive and permanent session deletion actions
Removes session transcript directories and related workspace, archive-marker, and projection-cache records
Exposes remote endpoints for session management
